tagline: An independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company focused on the Permian Basin.
hero_kpi_rationale: The combined production volume (BOE/d) is the primary growth driver for Diamondback, reflecting the impact of the Endeavor and Double Eagle acquisitions and organic development amid strong production expansion (+54% in 2025).
company_description: Diamondback Energy, Inc., an independent oil and natural gas company, acquires, develops, explores, and exploits unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas, the United States. The company primarily focuses on the development of the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations of the Midland Basin; and the Wolfcamp and Bone Spring formations of the Delaware Basin, both of which are part of the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico. Diamondback Energy, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: Revenues increased by 33% in 2025 to $13,453 million, driven by a 54% increase in combined volumes, despite a 13% decline in oil prices.
kpis.signal: 33% revenue growth driven by strong production growth.

kpis.name: Combined Production Volumes
kpis.explanation: Total production in barrels of oil equivalent per day.
kpis.description: Combined production reached 921,036 BOE/d in 2025, a significant increase driven by the Endeavor acquisition (41% of incremental volume) and Double Eagle (12%), as well as new wells (42%).
kpis.signal: 54% year-on-year jump, driven by acquisitions and new wells.

kpis.name: Oil Production
kpis.explanation: Quantity of oil produced each day.
kpis.description: Oil production increased from 336,954 to 497,156 barrels per day in 2025, representing 54% of total combined volume.
kpis.signal: 48% increase in oil production, a key growth engine.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin estimated at 32.1% in 2025 (vs 34.5% in 2024), reflecting acquisition integration and $579M increase in operating costs for acquired assets.
kpis.signal: High margin despite price volatility and acquisition impact.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new wells and infrastructure.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amounted to $7,809 million in 2025, down from $11,221 million in 2024 (the Endeavor acquisition year). The company expects $2.0-2.2B in LOE for 2026.
kpis.signal: Capex decline following the major acquisition year (Endeavor) in 2024.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount increased to 2.5K employees in 2025 (vs 2.1K in 2024), primarily due to the full-year impact of the Endeavor acquisition and compensation increases (+$47M).
kpis.signal: Headcount growth linked to Endeavor and Double Eagle acquisitions.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €71.06B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €14.88B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last seven fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $15.026B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.664B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Realized Oil Price
kpis.explanation: Average price received for a barrel of crude oil.
kpis.description: Average realized oil price decreased from $73.52 to $64.04 between 2024 and 2025, a 13% decline that partially offset the positive impact of volume growth (+54%).

kpis.name: Oil Asset Impairment
kpis.explanation: Non-cash loss on the value of oil reserves (SEC ceiling test).
kpis.description: A non-cash impairment of $3,652 million in 2025 (vs $0 in 2024) resulted from declining SEC oil prices. The company expects additional material impairments in Q1 2026 due to further price declines.
kpis.signal: Significant impairment charge linked to oil price decline in Q4 2025.

risks.title: Volatility of oil and natural gas prices
risks.summary: Oil and natural gas price volatility directly impacts operating cash flows and asset values (impairment).
risks.score_rationale: The company is fully dependent on oil and gas commodity prices, which are highly volatile. A 13% decline in oil prices in 2025 despite 54% volume growth illustrates this systemic risk. The company recorded a $3.7B impairment in Q4 2025.

risks.title: Dependence on financial markets for financing
risks.summary: Access to and cost of capital in financial markets can affect the company's ability to fund acquisitions, operations, and investments.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on capital markets to finance major acquisitions (Endeavor, Double Eagle) and its capex program ($7.8B in 2025). Access to credit and interest rates are critical to its expansion strategy.

risks.title: Credit and leverage risks
risks.summary: Credit risks can impact financing terms and financial flexibility, especially in low-price environments.
risks.score_rationale: The company has issued bonds (Senior Notes due 2026, 2029, 2031, 2051) and maintains credit facilities to fund acquisitions. Credit ratings influence refinancing costs and operational flexibility.

risks.title: Regulatory and environmental compliance
risks.summary: Evolving environmental regulations and laws may require additional investments and increase operating costs.
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly detailed in the provided excerpt, E&P operations are subject to federal and state (Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma) environmental regulations regarding emissions, wastewater, and site restoration.

risks.title: Reserve replacement and drilling productivity dependence
risks.summary: Inability to replace reserves or maintain drilling success rates would compromise long-term production growth.
risks.score_rationale: The growth model relies on replacing proved reserves and increasing production through new wells (42% of 2025 growth). Drilling success and development costs are critical.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.summary: Integration risks and contractual obligations related to acquisitions can impact synergy realization and financial performance.
risks.score_rationale: The company completed major acquisitions (Endeavor, Double Eagle) with transaction costs of $105M in 2025 and $303M in 2024. Operational integration and compliance with contractual obligations present risks.

risks.title: Liquidity and cash flow management risks
risks.summary: Liquidity and operating cash flow management are essential to meet debt obligations, fund acquisitions and investments, and maintain a safety buffer.
risks.score_rationale: Operating cash flow is sensitive to price volatility ($8.758B in 2025 vs $6.413B in 2024). The company must fund significant capex ($7.8B) and manage debt obligations while maintaining sufficient liquidity.

ai_positioning.summary: Diamondback Energy does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report for fiscal year 2025.
